metadata.title: Saves & Miis — Nebula
metadata.description: Backups, save import and Mii icons.

page.paragraph_2: Backups, save import and Mii icons.

backup.paragraph_1: Open Settings, then the GENERAL page, and choose Export saves. Choose where to keep the dated ZIP file.

dolphin.paragraph_1: In Dolphin, right-click Super Mario Galaxy and choose Open Wii Save Folder.
dolphin.paragraph_2: Open Settings, then the GENERAL page. Choose Import saves and select GameData.bin in that folder.
dolphin.paragraph_3: Choose Replace. Nebula moves your current save to a dated backup folder and restarts with the imported one.
dolphin.paragraph_4: Import saves also reads Wii SD card saves (data.bin), Switch saves (GameData.bin), Nebula.sav files and Nebula ZIP backups. Action Replay saves (.wii) cannot be read.

location.item_4: Android: inside the app. Use Export saves and Import saves.
location.paragraph_1: Replaced saves move to a saves-backup-<date> folder beside the saves folder. Saves folder on the GENERAL page opens it.
location.paragraph_2: Export a backup before a major update or a move to another computer.

miis.paragraph_1: Import Miis on the GENERAL page adds Miis from a Wii, DS, 3DS, Wii U, Switch, Mii Studio or Mii Creator to the file icon list.

footer.paragraph_1: A little closer to the stars.
